_how: Which PDFs the next deploy renders. Read by scripts/build-pdf.mjs.
rebuild: always render these. Each entry is a journal key ('data', 'deep-dives/caching'), or one PDF or page path from public/journals.json.
only_listed: true renders nothing else; every other PDF is copied from the PDF cache, even if its page changed.
Those stay marked out of date, so the next build with only_listed false renders them. PDFs never rendered before are always rendered.
only_listed: false is the normal mode: render the listed PDFs plus every PDF whose page changed.
Check before pushing: npm run pdf -- --dry-run. Render everything: run the workflow by hand with 'rebuild_pdfs'.
